purpose: Reviewable general rules and conditional PK/PD knowledge for dynamic data requirements.

layers.name: General Rules
layers.purpose: Source authority, objective alignment, scientific meaning, context scope, version binding, actionable review outcomes and carrying unresolved items to the step that needs them. Runtime sends the full canonical text.

layers.name: PK/PD data requirements
layers.purpose: MP001-MP009 and MP011 assess only objective-specific input definitions, source evidence, coverage and gaps. MP009 includes conditional PD-target inputs, not target estimation. They do not choose analytical methods or qualify results. MP010 has moved to the deferred PTA reference. Each profile lists data_roles and one condition trigger per conditional input and data check; host code uses them only to decide which conditions of an already selected profile apply to a labelled dataset.

layers.name: Deferred analysis guidance
layers.purpose: Preserve prior NCA/animal PK calculation and evaluation content with its original review status and source version. Not loaded by DR/DC; future activation requires the applicable analysis-module review.

layers.name: Deferred translation guidance
layers.purpose: Later translation-module review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.

layers.name: Deferred human simulation guidance
layers.purpose: Later human PK simulation-module review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.

layers.name: Deferred binding analysis guidance
layers.purpose: Later binding/free-exposure analysis review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.

layers.name: Deferred IVIVE guidance
layers.purpose: Later IVIVE analysis-module review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.

layers.name: Deferred PK/PD index guidance
layers.purpose: Later PK/PD index-analysis review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.

layers.name: Deferred PTA guidance
layers.purpose: Later PTA handoff and analysis review only; not loaded by Data requirements agents.

layers.name: Project rules
layers.purpose: Authoritative project constraints, such as an approved species minimum or permission for human-source in vitro evidence. These are not stored as general defaults.

profile_review_order: MP001 Data requirements for observed peaks and finite-window NCA
MP002 Data requirements for terminal-dependent NCA endpoints
MP003 Data requirements for animal CL and Vss
MP011 Data requirements for urinary excretion and renal clearance
MP004 Data requirements for animal PK modeling
MP009 Data requirements for PK/PD indices and PD targets
MP006 Human PK simulation input definitions
MP007 Data requirements for binding and unbound exposure
MP008 Data requirements for in vitro clearance translation
flow: DR receives reviewed objective/context, published project rules and the candidate method library
DR defines explicit versus proposed needs with evidence, conditions and method references
Each file reviewer receives assigned requirements, selected scientific context and only their linked profiles
DC-review independently checks applicability and authority, preserving missing endpoints and later-stage gaps
Data preparation/QC and existing downstream reviews keep their own acceptance boundaries
not_implemented_by_this_change: New NCA, modeling, IVIVE or PTA numerical engines
Scientific approval of the draft profiles
validation_boundary: Contract, provenance and routing tests do not demonstrate real-model scientific extraction accuracy or predictive validity.

assessment_statuses.AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE: Source-backed input availability only; not result acceptance
assessment_statuses.UNRESOLVED: Partially met or uncertain; explain what is available and what remains missing or requires downstream analysis
assessment_statuses.MISSING: Required input not located in the permitted reviewed sources
assessment_statuses.DEFERRED: Documented later-stage input; not a current-stage default blocker

ui: General rules and method profiles are available through the allowlisted Rules JSON catalog. Existing server processes require normal reload to expose changed Python routes; no service restart is performed by this change.
profile_ordering_policy: The library presents index data requirements immediately after animal PK data requirements and before translation. IDs stay stable. This is review/context priority, not execution order; PK and index branches remain independently applicable and actual file dependencies still govern execution.
